final_message: Verified the `--resume-note` implementation from the first attempt against the completion conditions. Re-ran the two validations that were `not_run`: `validate:history-links` and a schema check of a `pipeline-state.json` that contains `resume_notes`. Both passed. Recorded an existing schema gap (`artifacts` is missing from the schema) in the ticket's remaining issues.
handoff: Options and decisions: the option name is `--resume-note <text>` (repeatable). It applies only to `exec run --register` with a single ID. Notes are inserted before the conventions reference in the worktree plan and recorded in `resume_notes` in `pipeline-state.json`. The reasons are in the ticket's response section.

CHANGELOG (Added): `exec run --register <PJR-ID> --resume --resume-from executor` gains `--resume-note <text>` (repeatable). Before resuming, it adds a resume-instructions section before the conventions reference in the run's plan and records the notes and time in `resume_notes` in `pipeline-state.json` (PJR-5F1Y).

Existing gap outside this item: `docs/specdojo/schemas/v1/pipeline-state.schema.yaml` lacks the `artifacts` field written by `src/exec/pipeline-state.ts`, so real run `pipeline-state.json` files fail `npm run validate:schema:file` with additional properties. Handle the schema addition in a separate register item.
